South Surrey presale projects on my list

Three projects on my list sit in the South Surrey area, going by the locations the sources give: Calais at Semiahmoo Town Centre, Rockford at 128 Street and 17 Avenue in Ocean Park, and Harlowe at 16485 18 Avenue, described by its sources as Sunnyside Heights and Grandview Heights. All three are scheduled to complete between 2027 and 2028.

items.t: : the Real Estate Development Marketing Act s. 21 gives a 7-day rescission period from the later of signing the purchase agreement and acknowledging receipt of the disclosure statement, and deposits are held in trust under s. 18. The disclosure statement — not the listing card, not the presentation centre — governs completion dates, deposits and what is being bought; have a lawyer read it inside the 7-day window.

The regulator: in British Columbia, real estate trading services are regulated by the BC Financial Services Authority (BCFSA), and BCFSA states a licensed professional must only work for either the buyer or the seller in a transaction and must inform unrepresented consumers of the risks of dealing with a professional representing another party.

City plans and zoning — two municipalities, never mixed: Surrey buildings sit under the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 21900 (adopted June 15, 2026) — the former PlanSurrey 2013 OCP, Bylaw No. 18020, is REPLACED and cited only as predecessor — and Surrey Zoning Bylaw, 1993, No. 12000. White Rock buildings (Foster Martin) sit under White Rock's OWN bylaws: Zoning Bylaw 2024 No. 2506 and OCP 2017 No. 2220 — never Surrey's. Surrey SSMUH / suites (Surrey lots only): a maximum of 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop, under the July 8, 2024 changes; a secondary suite's habitable floor area may not exceed 40% of the principal dwelling unit.

items.t: This page carries the open-house time defect on one card — documented here, on this page. The Foster Martin card (606 1475 Foster Street) shows a separate time block reading "12:00 PM - 04:00 PM PST" while the line beneath it reads "Open House on Sunday, November 1, 2026 11:00AM - 3:00PM" — exactly one hour apart. Which time is authoritative is not verified.
Harlowe's board filing and its own description disagree about its sub-area.

A presale's competition is the whole resale pool, not other presales alone. 593 combined Condos & Townhomes listings were active community-wide in September 2026 at a $700,000 combined median, 99% sale-to-list and 33 DOM — a presale priced today competes with that pool on completion day, and no source separates the new-build share of it. (SnapStats, September 2026)
Calais is described in presale-directory sources as South Surrey's first tower.

The page's completed-communities list is the tell. The same page that sells "new construction & presales" expressly lists eleven finished townhome communities as "finished complexes, not presales" — Fox and Aikins North, South Village, Hyde Park, Greenway, Arista, Jacobsen, The Heights, SOHO, Blu Living, Brownstones at Morgan Crossing and Grandview Corners. Read every card against that admission before assuming a listing is a presale.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in South Surrey New Construction Presales

items.t: REDMA block (the presale frame): The page describes deposits as "usually 10%–20% total, staged over construction" — that range is page copy, not verified as a rule; the disclosure statement for the specific project governs its deposit schedule. Verify current REDMA rules on BCFSA's site and have a lawyer read the disclosure statement inside the rescission window.

Warranty (page copy): the page lists a 2-5-10 warranty (2 years materials and labour, 5 years building envelope, 10 years structure) — carried as the page's statement; the specific warranty for a project is in its disclosure statement.

City plans (Surrey ground): Surrey 2050 OCP Bylaw No. 21900 (adopted Jun 15, 2026) — current; Bylaw 18020 REPLACED, never cite as current. Zoning Bylaw No. 12000. White Rock addresses in the feed answer to White Rock's own bylaws — no Surrey rule is asserted for a White Rock parcel.

ALR block (completeness only — no ALR parcel documented here): subdivision needs ALC approval; residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); caps principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); farm class three-tier ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

BC strata block (the built-form product this page sells is strata; applies in full to any bare-land strata lot): Form B (within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page); depreciation reports 5-year cycle for 5+ lots since Jul 1, 2024; min 10% CRF since Nov 1, 2023; rental bylaws VOID since Nov 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss.123.1/123.2 + May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw.

PTT / new-home exemption: general tiers 1% / 2% to $2M / 3% above, plus further 2% on the residential portion above $3M. Worked examples: $500K → $8,000; $700K → $12,000; $800K → $14,000 ($6,000 fully-qualifying FTHB); $900K → $16,000; $1.0M → $18,000; $1.2M → $22,000; $1.5M → $28,000; $1.8M → $34,000; $2.0M → $38,000; $3.5M → $93,000 including the further 2% tier. Newly Built Home Exemption: full to $1,100,000, partial to $1,150,000 (page copy, consistent with the Province frame) — a new-HOME exemption, not bare land.

GST on new housing / vacant land: new housing is generally GST-taxable (the presale case); for vacant land itself, CRA GI-003 level ONLY — developer/business sales and newly subdivided lots generally TAXABLE, an individual's personal-use land generally exempt, finer points not confirmed.

Regulator: BCFSA regulates BC real estate trading services; a licensed professional works for either buyer or seller only and must inform unrepresented consumers of the risks of dealing with a professional representing another party. Registering with your own agent before a first presentation-centre visit matters for representation (page copy).

faq.a: Project prices, deposits and completion dates are not verified (developer source) beyond those stated wordings — the disclosure statement governs any purchase.
faq.q: Which named presale projects are documented for South Surrey?

faq.a: Under REDMA the developer must give the buyer a disclosure statement before signing, and the buyer can cancel by written notice within 7 days of the later of signing and acknowledging the disclosure statement (s.21), with deposits held in trust (s.18). Have a lawyer read the disclosure statement inside that window.
faq.q: What protection does a BC presale buyer have?

faq.a: No. "Estimated completion is early 2028" is the developer's estimate in listing text; the disclosure statement's date range and amendment history are the only project documents that govern. Never treat a card's completion wording as a date you can plan a move on.
faq.q: Can I plan a move on a card's completion wording?

faq.a: GST: yes, 5% on a developer sale, subject to the First-Time Home Buyers' GST/HST Rebate (100% of GST to $1M, maximum $50,000, phasing to $1.5M, agreements on/after March 20, 2025) and the older GST New Housing Rebate. PTT: the general tiers apply, subject to the Newly Built Home Exemption (full to $1,100,000, partial to $1,150,000) for a qualifying new principal residence. A resale — even a nearly-new one like the King & Crescent card — carries no GST.
faq.q: Do I pay GST and property transfer tax on a new South Surrey home?

faq.a: Harlowe's 61 condominiums and Calais (in Semiahmoo Town Centre) are presale product, not completed Grandview apartment stock.
faq.q: Is Grandview Heights short of apartment buildings generally?

faq.a: Under REDMA the developer must give you a disclosure statement before you sign, you may rescind by written notice within 7 days of the later of signing and acknowledging it (s.21), and deposits are held in trust (s.18).
faq.q: What protection does a BC presale buyer have?

faq.a: No. None of Harlowe, Calais or Rockford carries a stated 55+ age restriction in any developer source checked — Harlowe/Calais/Rockford are explicitly NOT 55+. Adaptable-homes language (Calais) is design, not an age bylaw.
All project specifics are not verified (developer source); the disclosure statement governs.

No. The page's own editorial says the listings "show newer and new-build homes wherever they are in South Surrey and White Rock", and the cards read include a nearly-new resale condo (Willow at King & Crescent), a resale unit in a sold-out completed tower (Foster Martin), move-in-ready completed stock (Fox & Aikins South) and a true presale (Harlowe, with an estimated early-2028 completion in its listing text).
faq.q: Are all the homes on this page presales?

faq.a: The page states (site copy) that a qualifying new principal residence up to $1,100,000 is exempt from property transfer tax under BC's Newly Built Home Exemption (partial to $1,150,000), and that the federal First-Time Home Buyers' GST Rebate can return up to 100% of the 5% GST on a new home up to $1 million (maximum $50,000). Verify both against the Province and the Canada Revenue Agency for your own purchase — neither threshold was opened on an official page in this pass.
faq.q: Do I pay property transfer tax and GST on a new South Surrey home?

faq.a: No source used here separates them: SnapStats publishes no new-construction cut, and the page itself states FVREB does not report new construction separately. The whole-market context is 600 Detached listings (median $1,628,000) and 593 Condos & Townhomes listings (median $700,000) in September 2026 — (SnapStats, September 2026)
